workflows.label: Input Shaping Frequency

parameters.label: Y end
constraints: pinned implementation accidentally rechecks freqEndX, so freqEndY has no enforced 500 Hz ceiling

effects.detail: Emits the damping setup on layer 1, then linearly interpolates X/Y (or combined A) shaping frequency.
Applies single-wall spiral settings and disables competing PA/resonance effects.

localBinding.detail: No current ActionRegistry action exposes this distinct pinned workflow.

notes: The dialog recommends damping 0 but initializes 0.15.
The implementation accepts a zero start frequency and damping 0, contrary to its warning text.

workflows.label: Input Shaping Damping/zeta factor

effects.detail: Emits fixed X/Y frequencies on layer 1, then linearly interpolates the combined damping factor.
Applies single-wall spiral settings and disables competing PA/resonance effects.

localBinding.detail: No current ActionRegistry action exposes this distinct pinned workflow.

notes: Zero frequency is accepted by the implementation despite the dialog warning text.
